trait_oos_soul_0_info: A soul with no history yet. It has lived once, or not at all.
trait_oos_soul_1_info: A soul that has started to remember. Faint echoes of past lives stir within.
trait_oos_soul_2_info: A soul that wanders from life to life, gathering experience along the way.
trait_oos_soul_3_info: A soul hardened by many lives and many deeds.
trait_oos_soul_4_info: A soul climbing beyond the ordinary cycle of life and death.
trait_oos_soul_5_info: A soul whose deeds are told as legends across the ages.
trait_oos_soul_6_info: A soul that has crossed the boundary between the mortal and the beyond.
trait_oos_soul_7_info: A soul at the summit of the ladder, bound to no single life.
trait_oos_immortal_info: A being that cannot stay dead. When it dies, it returns to life at once.
trait_oos_infinite_reincarnation_info: A soul that will be reborn forever.
trait_oos_protagonist_info: A soul that returned knowing everything, with its past gifts intact and a golden finger of its own.
trait_oos_gf_absorb_info: Every kill heals it and grows its health and damage. Kills may steal a positive trait from the victim.
trait_oos_gf_absorb_info_2: A unique power of the Protagonist.
trait_oos_gf_system_info: Every experience level grants a random positive trait.
trait_oos_gf_system_info_2: A unique power of the Protagonist.
trait_oos_gf_second_chance_info: Survives a fatal blow with full health and brief invulnerability. Needs years to recharge.
trait_oos_gf_second_chance_info_2: A unique power of the Protagonist.
trait_oos_gf_aura_info: Allies of its kingdom nearby are inspired and empowered. It also gains renown.
trait_oos_gf_aura_info_2: A unique power of the Protagonist.
trait_oos_gf_memory_info: Every past life of this soul makes it permanently stronger.
trait_oos_gf_memory_info_2: A unique power of the Protagonist.
oos_cfg_all_worlds Description: When on, reincarnation can use souls saved in any world. When off, only the current world. The Pantheon always lets you browse every world.
oos_cfg_priority_min_level Description: Souls of this level or higher are drawn first more often. 8 turns the priority off.
oos_cfg_priority_chance Description: Chance that a newborn draws its soul only from the priority levels. Otherwise it draws from the lower levels. If one group is empty, the other is used.
oos_cfg_protagonist_denominator Descript: Chance that a newborn becomes the Protagonist: it takes a random soul of any level, keeps all its traits and receives a random golden finger. Must be a positive whole number.
oos_cfg_finger_absorb Description: Weight in the draw of the Protagonist's golden finger. 0 never draws it. Every kill heals and grows health and damage, and may steal a positive trait.
oos_cfg_finger_system Description: Weight in the draw of the Protagonist's golden finger. 0 never draws it. Every experience level grants a random positive trait.
oos_cfg_finger_second_chance Description: Weight in the draw of the Protagonist's golden finger. 0 never draws it. Survives a fatal blow with full health, once every 50 years.
oos_cfg_finger_aura Description: Weight in the draw of the Protagonist's golden finger. 0 never draws it. Nearby allies of its kingdom are inspired and empowered.
oos_cfg_finger_memory Description: Weight in the draw of the Protagonist's golden finger. 0 never draws it. Every past life makes it permanently stronger.
oos_cfg_level_thresholds Description: Seven ascending whole numbers separated by commas: points needed for levels 1 to 7.
oos_cfg_weight_lives Description: How many points each reincarnation is worth.
oos_cfg_weight_deeds Description: How much deeds recorded in the life history are worth.
oos_cfg_weight_age Description: How much the years a soul has existed across all its lives are worth.
oos_cfg_short_life_gap Description: A soul that dies this many years or more younger than in its previous life loses points instead of gaining them. 0 turns the rule off.
oos_cfg_short_life_penalty: Short life: points lost per year
oos_cfg_short_life_penalty Description: Points lost for each year the life was shorter than the previous one.
oos_cfg_short_life_cap Description: The most points a soul can lose from a single short life.
oos_cfg_inherit_traits_level Description: Souls of this level bring back 1 old trait, one more for each level above it, and all traits at level 7. Lower levels only keep the name. 8 turns trait inheritance off.
oos_cfg_max_souls Description: Per world and per level. When a folder goes over this number, the oldest souls are deleted. 0 means no limit.
oos_cfg_decorate_name Description: Adds a symbol for the soul level before the name and one apostrophe for each past life after it.
oos_cfg_top_of_ladder: Level 7 grants Immortal or Infinite Reincarnation
oos_cfg_top_of_ladder Description: When on, a level 7 soul receives Immortal or Infinite Reincarnation based on its life history. The trait is lost if the soul falls below level 7.
oos_cfg_debug_log Description: Writes a line to the mod log every time a unit with a soul dies, with its points and level.
oos_cfg_save_level_0 Description: Whether souls of level 0 are saved when they die.
oos_cfg_save_level_1 Description: Whether souls of level 1 are saved when they die.
oos_cfg_save_level_2 Description: Whether souls of level 2 are saved when they die.
oos_cfg_save_level_3 Description: Whether souls of level 3 are saved when they die.
oos_cfg_save_level_4 Description: Whether souls of level 4 are saved when they die.
oos_cfg_save_level_5 Description: Whether souls of level 5 are saved when they die.
oos_cfg_save_level_6 Description: Whether souls of level 6 are saved when they die.
oos_cfg_save_level_7 Description: Whether souls of level 7 are saved when they die.
oos_tab Description: Everything about souls, reincarnation and the Pantheon.
oos_pantheon Description: Browse the saved souls and bring them back.
oos_pantheon_hint:
Revive: returns as an adult with its own name.
Reborn: returns as a newborn with the next life mark.
